svg.text: Mindee → OpenAccountants · VAT-on-invoices demo [MOCK (set OA_MCP_TOKEN + MINDEE_API_KEY to go live)]
📄 mt_domestic.json
Mindee → Valletta Software Ltd (MT) → Sliema Trading Ltd (MT)
net EUR 10000.00 · VAT EUR 1800.00 (18%) · customer VAT ID MT12345678
OpenAccountants → Malta — VAT place of supply & reverse charge (tier 1, signed off by Michael Cutajar, CPA (Malta))
✅ Correct domestic VAT (18%)
MT domestic supply taxed at the verified standard rate 18%.
rule: MT domestic supply → standard rate 18%.
📄 mt_to_fr_WRONG.json
Mindee → Valletta Software Ltd (MT) → Lefebvre Distribution SARL (FR)
net EUR 10000.00 · VAT EUR 1800.00 (18%) · customer VAT ID FR40303265045
OpenAccountants → Malta — VAT place of supply & reverse charge (tier 1, signed off by Michael Cutajar, CPA (Malta))
⚠️ VAT charged in error — should be reverse charge
Intra-EU B2B supply (MT → FR, customer VAT ID FR40303265045). Supplier should invoice 0% and the customer self-accounts. This invoice charged EUR 1800.00.
rule: Intra-EU B2B: place of supply is the customer's country → reverse charge.
→ handoff: request_accountant_review (route to the named jurisdiction lead)
📄 mt_to_fr_reverse_charge.json
Mindee → Valletta Software Ltd (MT) → Lefebvre Distribution SARL (FR)
net EUR 10000.00 · VAT EUR 0.00 (0%) · customer VAT ID FR40303265045
OpenAccountants → Malta — VAT place of supply & reverse charge (tier 1, signed off by Michael Cutajar, CPA (Malta))
✅ Reverse charge correctly applied
Intra-EU B2B supply (MT → FR). Supplier correctly invoiced 0% VAT; customer self-accounts.
rule: Intra-EU B2B: place of supply is the customer's country → reverse charge.
